requirements.title: Processor provides ISO_C_BINDING and its required public entities
requirements.definition: The processor shall provide ISO_C_BINDING and make accessible C_NULL_PTR, C_NULL_FUNPTR, Table 18.1 character constants (C_NULL_CHAR, C_ALERT, C_BACKSPACE, C_FORM_FEED, C_NEW_LINE, C_CARRIAGE_RETURN, C_HORIZONTAL_TAB, C_VERTICAL_TAB), Table 18.2 kind constants (C_SIGNED_CHAR, C_SHORT, C_INT, C_LONG, C_LONG_LONG, C_SIZE_T, C_INT8_T, C_INT16_T, C_INT32_T, C_INT64_T, C_INT_LEAST8_T, C_INT_LEAST16_T, C_INT_LEAST32_T, C_INT_LEAST64_T, C_INT_FAST8_T, C_INT_FAST16_T, C_INT_FAST32_T, C_INT_FAST64_T, C_INTMAX_T, C_INTPTR_T, C_PTRDIFF_T, C_FLOAT, C_DOUBLE, C_LONG_DOUBLE, C_FLOAT_COMPLEX, C_DOUBLE_COMPLEX, C_LONG_DOUBLE_COMPLEX, C_BOOL, C_CHAR), C_PTR, C_FUNPTR, and the 18.2.3 procedures (C_ASSOCIATED, C_F_POINTER, C_F_PROCPOINTER, C_F_STRPOINTER, C_FUNLOC, C_LOC, C_SIZEOF, F_C_STRING).

pending.iso-c-binding-procedures-accessible: Fortran-only plan: import the procedure names C_ASSOCIATED, C_F_POINTER, C_F_PROCPOINTER, C_F_STRPOINTER, C_FUNLOC, C_LOC, C_SIZEOF, and F_C_STRING by ONLY list. Executable semantic plans for C_ASSOCIATED and C_F_POINTER are in 18.2.3.2 and 18.2.3.3; C_F_PROCPOINTER, C_F_STRPOINTER, C_FUNLOC, C_LOC, C_SIZEOF, and F_C_STRING are deferred to 18.2.3.4 through 18.2.3.9 sibling catalogues.

requirements.oracle:
Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first and assert only portable Clause 18 properties: ISO_C_BINDING accessibility, exact named-constant relations, exact logical results, pointer association status, shape and lower-bound results, values recovered through C_LOC/C_F_POINTER round trips, or mixed Fortran/C calls through declared interoperable interfaces. Processor-dependent kind values, pointer bit patterns, C address numeric values, companion-processor availability, storage alignment, and C library details are not asserted.

S18.2.1-001 required ISO_C_BINDING entities fixture: the fixture imports ISO_C_BINDING by intrinsic USE, imports all required null, Table 18.1 character, Table 18.2 kind constants and C_PTR/C_FUNPTR by ONLY, and observes exact null association, constant assignment, character length/value, and scalar pointer declarations. The C_F_STRPOINTER/F_C_STRING procedure-access facet remains pending because the f2023 reference on this host does not provide them.

Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: later Clause 18 interoperability conditions, ISO_C_BINDING procedures after 18.2.3.3, ISO_Fortran_binding.h descriptor semantics, and companion C processor details.
